headline: Saudi Aramco Evacuates Dhahran Staff Amid Houthi Clashes and High Oil Prices
summary: Saudi Aramco instructed personnel to evacuate Dhahran as clashes with Yemen's Houthis continued. The unrest comes even as Persian Gulf crude exports recover toward prewar levels, keeping energy prices elevated.
why: Saudi Aramco is the world's largest oil-producing company and Dhahran hosts its core operational headquarters. Supply disruption threats in Saudi Arabia have an immediate impact on global energy prices.

impacts.name: Crude Oil
impacts.why: Heightened security risks at core Saudi oil installations threaten production and transit security.

why_moved: Crude oil prices remained elevated as Saudi Aramco ordered evacuations in Dhahran following renewed Houthi clashes, stoking Middle East supply fears.
